HOME_PAGE.TITLE: Save Today, Own Tomorrow — Your Future Starts Here
HOME_PAGE.DESCRIPTION: Manage your savings with exclusive discounts and cash-backs from top brands on every deposit. It’s free, flexible, and no hidden fees.

SLOGANS.DESCRIPTION: Simple, rewarding, and flexible—saving has never been easier.

DISCOUNTS.TITLE: Discounts & Cash-backs
DISCOUNTS.DESCRIPTION: Save smarter by earning exclusive rewards and cash-backs from top brands as you build towards your financial goals.

ZERO_COST.TITLE: Zero Cost, Total Control
ZERO_COST.DESCRIPTION: Enjoy total control over your savings with no hidden fees or extra charges—what you save is entirely yours to manage.

WITH_DRAW.TITLE: Withdraw Anytime
WITH_DRAW.DESCRIPTION: Your savings are always available whenever you need them. Withdraw without penalties or restrictions, anytime.

HOW_IT_WORKS.TITLE: How it works
HOW_IT_WORKS.HEADING: Create Your Account
HOW_IT_WORKS.DESCRIPTION: Getting started is simple. Sign up in just a few clicks, and you're ready to begin your savings journey. No hidden fees, no complicated forms—just you and your goals.

FUND_YOUR_WALLET.TITLE: Fund Your Wallet, Earn Rewards
FUND_YOUR_WALLET.DESCRIPTION: Top up your wallet with recurring, one-time deposits, or round-ups from your linked card. Whether it's 5 or 500 riyals, you're in control—adjust, pause, or speed up anytime.

SAVE_TOGETHER.TITLE: Save Together, Reach Goals Faster
SAVE_TOGETHER.DESCRIPTION: Let your friends and family pitch in to your brand wallet. They can help you get closer to that big purchase or provide a little boost when you need it most.

TIME_TO_GRAB.TITLE: Time to Grab What’s Yours
TIME_TO_GRAB.DESCRIPTION: Once you reach your savings goal, make your purchase just like using a debit card—no debt, no hassle. You own it outright, and all the credit goes to you!

BOOST_YOUR_WALLET.TITLE: Boost Your Wallet with Brand Rewards
BOOST_YOUR_WALLET.DESCRIPTION: Save with the brands you love and watch your cash rewards grow as you get closer to achieving your goals—completely hassle-free!

YOUR_SAVINGS.DESCRIPTION: Take control of your future! Save smarter with help from brands you love, making your money work harder.

TOP_UP.HEADING: Save at Your Own Pace, Your Own Way
TOP_UP.DESCRIPTION: We’ve made saving simple by giving you multiple ways to fund your wallet, so you can pick what works best for you.

RECURRING_DEPOSITS.TITLE: Recurring Deposits
RECURRING_DEPOSITS.DESCRIPTION: Set it and forget it! Schedule automatic deposits on a weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly basis. Your savings grow effortlessly while you focus on other things.

ONE_TIME_DEPOSITS.TITLE: One-time Deposits
ONE_TIME_DEPOSITS.DESCRIPTION: Add money whenever it suits you, giving you complete flexibility to save at your own pace.

ROUND_UP_DEPOSITS.TITLE: Round-ups Deposits
ROUND_UP_DEPOSITS.DESCRIPTION: Automatically round up your everyday purchases to the nearest riyal and save the difference.

CROWD_SAVINGS_DEPOSITS.DESCRIPTION: Let friends and family contribute directly to your wallet, helping you reach your savings goals faster.

ABOUT_US.DESCRIPTION: We help you save for high-ticket purchases with ease. Our brand wallets offer a smarter way to reach your big goals, unlocking exclusive rewards as you save.

WHO_ARE_WE.TITLE: Who We Are
WHO_ARE_WE.DESCRIPTION: Snbla is a savings-focused fintech company committed to helping people in Saudi Arabia save smarter. We believe that reaching big goals shouldn’t require debt or credit.
WHO_ARE_WE.DESCRIPTION-2: We partner with top brands to create a dedicated space where customers can save and unlock rewards—combining savings, special offers, and exclusive deals in one easy-to-use platform.

OUR_MISSION.TITLE: Our Mission
OUR_MISSION.DESCRIPTION: We’re transforming the way people save for life’s big purchases. By connecting customers with brands, we’re creating a smarter way to reach financial goals—one savings deposit at a time. Together, we’re making high-ticket items more accessible, rewarding, and within reach.
